title: CONVERT ( DATE ( 2024, 1, 31 ), STRING ) reads 1/31/2024

source.quote: Returns the following table of a single column of String data type
source.supports: the example { 1, DATE(2017, 1, 1), TRUE, "A" } is shown returning 1, 1/1/2017, TRUE, A as strings

source.quote: Returns the value of Expression, translated to Datatype
source.supports: CONVERT to STRING turns the date into text; the page does not show the text

derivation: CONVERT to STRING is taken to use the same conversion as the implicit one. The table constructor example shows that conversion for a date at midnight in en-US as 1/1/2017, so 31 January 2024 reads 1/31/2024.
alternative: No source shows CONVERT of a date to STRING. If it kept the time, or used an ISO form, the result would be 1/31/2024 12:00:00 AM or 2024-01-31 00:00:00.
